test_title: PYST 211: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 1st Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six delivery boys, U, V, W, X, Y and Z, are standing in a row next to each other to collect their goods from the stock room. Z is to the immediate left of W. Z and Y are at the extreme ends of the row. W is exactly between Z and V. U is to the immediate left of X. Y is to the immediate right of X. Which delivery boy is at the fourth position from the right?
solution:
Six delivery boys, U, V, W, X, Y and Z, are standing in a row next to each other to collect their goods from the stock room.

1) Z is to the immediate left of W and Z and Y are at the extreme ends of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a6173ee249d7b8c1980d64307b2cebe56b7311664f7406efd5bd3e4313f3b4d.png] 

2) W is exactly between Z and V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c704afeee5abc5a0c5c2ed87f1ce304c03a99a47369ba28fc44b78e906cbc69.png] 

3) U is to the immediate left of X and Y is to the immediate right of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e668a328657113745dd3647b7ffb5d377b141e2b8e8d5553902eaaa4c05838dd.png] 

∴ Here, 'V' is standing at fourth position from right in the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"V".**
